Enabled, but another keyboard is selected.
On: tap Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win to apply it to the next key, double-tap to lock it. Off: modifiers are only held while touched, which suits games that use them on their own.
Tap here to open the keyboard

In a Moonlight stream, open the keyboard (three-finger tap, or from Moonlight’s in-stream menu). Every key goes to the PC as a real key press.

• Alt+Tab: tap the Alt+Tab shortcut to jump to the previous window. To pick any window, double-tap Alt to lock it, tap Tab until the window you want is selected, then tap Alt again.
• Alt+F4, Win+D, Win+Tab and Task Manager are one tap in the top row.
• Hold a shortcut to keep its keys held down.
• Fn switches to F1–F12, navigation keys and a number pad.

Note: Moonlight reserves Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Q (quit stream), +Z (release mouse) and +C (toggle cursor). Those combos are never sent to the PC.
